status: Blank actual capacity; illustrative source calendar is not availability
accounting: Estimate the saved current scope by stage and record observed hours in the existing job receipt. Include writing, review, launch, handoff and the correction tail. Reserve recurring work from its actual agreed units. Add activation/exit only once; sales labor belongs to sales. Shared unexpected recovery is not sellable. Unattended renders are elapsed time.

founder_availability_input.certainty: Owner confirms flexible availability and no planned closures. Specific booked delivery/review slots and measured stage hours still need confirmation.
founder_availability_input.interpreted_as: Strong availability intent; V5 60-hour total-work ceiling retained; not a confirmed client booking calendar.
founder_availability_input.latest_owner_statement: Flexible availability including potential weekends; no planned closures. Owner will update the website and notify clients when away.
founder_availability_input.weekend_work: Optional overflow by owner choice; not included in promised baseline capacity.

allocation_accounting: One unique allocation ID per dated work block. actual_hours is observed work against plan, excluding separately recorded unexpected_hours. Use 0 for explicitly unperformed future work; null is unknown. Monthly total uses max(planned,actual)+unexpected. Reference the existing job receipt, not a new time ledger. Leave calendar_months empty to derive totals; entered summaries must reconcile.
